<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.selected = 2
      this.state.people = [
        { id: 1, name: 'Ada' },
        { id: 2, name: 'Grace' },
      ]
    }

    select(id) {
      this.state.selected = id
    }
  }
</script>

{#if state.people}
  <ul>
    {#each state.people as person}
      <li class:selected={person.id === state.selected}>
        <button onclick="fez.select({person.id})">{person.name}</button>
      </li>
    {/each}
  </ul>
{:else}
  <p>No people found.</p>
{/if}
